title: llama.cpp Multimodal  GGUF File Parsing Out-Of-Bounds Write Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of llama.cpp. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must open a malicious file.
The specific flaw exists within the processing of multimodal projector GGUF files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a write past the end of an allocated object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.
addtionnal_details:
llama.cpp has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32130
